description: Tractor-Info is a free web database of specifications for more than 15,000 machines, 10,714 tractor models and 4,967 lawn tractor models from over 333 brands, with horsepower, engine make and displacement, transmission type and gears, dimensions, tyres, hydraulic flow, PTO power and production years, plus side-by-side comparison of any two models. It is run by the Tractor-Info site. Coverage is worldwide brands such as John Deere with 824 models, Massey Ferguson, Kubota, Case IH, Fendt and Zetor, spanning more than a century from 1908 to 2025. The pages are available free online without sign-up in seven languages; no licence or bulk download is stated. Caveats: sources and verification of figures are not documented on the page read. For simulation it supplies machine power, size and hydraulic attributes for models of farm field operations, fuel and energy demand and the performance of agricultural equipment fleets. It is related to the TractorData.com record in this catalogue, a similar database.
